In today's episode of The Daily Brief, we cover 2 major stories shaping the Indian economy and global markets:
1.Why Reliance and Nayara Are Now Focusing on India’s Fuel Market
Private oil giants like Reliance and Nayara, once export-focused, are now shifting attention to India’s growing fuel market. Weak global demand, better refining margins due to cheap Russian oil, and booming Indian consumption are driving this pivot. With aggressive pricing and expanding retail networks, they’re rapidly gaining market share at home.
